label: Diagram 9
caption: Diagram 9 Effective clear width of doors
description:
Diagram 9, titled 'Effective clear width of doors', is a technical drawing illustrating design considerations for manually operated non-powered entrance doors. The diagram shows two side-on views of a door opening to demonstrate how clear width is measured.

On the left, a door is shown in an open position. An arc indicates the path of the door leaf, and a dimension line with arrows measures the 'Effective clear width (door stop to projecting ironmongery)'. This measurement starts from the door stop and ends at the furthest point of the projecting hardware.

On the right, a second door is shown. An arc indicates the door's movement, and a dimension line measures the 'Effective clear width (door stop to door leaf)'. This measurement starts from the door stop and ends at the edge of the door leaf itself.

A central vertical dimension line specifies a '300mm minimum unless door is power operated'. This dimension refers to the clear width shown in the diagrams.
